battle.name: 北伐戰爭
battle.theater: 粵漢鐵路走廊與湘鄂贛戰區
battle.brief: 民國十五年七月九日，蔣中正在廣州誓師北伐，國民革命軍分三路北進，次第打倒吳佩孚、孫傳芳與張作霖三大軍閥。八月二十七日汀泗橋、三十日賀勝橋連破直系主力，十月十日武昌易手。卡面所配的三八式步槍是日軍制式步槍，在北伐後期奉軍的東北戰線上大量裝備，亦隨繳獲流散全國各軍。

kit.name: 三八式步槍
kit.history: 三八式步槍是日本陸軍在二戰前的主力步槍，以其可靠性和精確度聞名，被廣泛用於步兵班及前線作戰。

countries: 北伐以廣州國民政府領導的國民革命軍為一方，以北洋政府各派系組成的聯軍為另一方。出師時國民革命軍共八個軍、十万餘人：第一軍軍長何應欽，第四軍軍長李濟深（後由張發奎接任），第二軍軍長譚延闓，第三軍為滇系、軍長朱培德，第六軍軍長程潛，另有以廣西人為主的新桂系第七軍，以及由貴州軍閥袁祖銘收編改組而成的第九軍、第十軍。各軍多設政治部與黨代表制度，蔣中正兼任國民革命軍總政治部主任，黨務直接嵌進指揮鏈。北方的直系總司令吳佩孚出任討賊聯軍總司令，以葉開鑫為討賊聯軍湘軍總司令，據兩湖與河南；江浙皖閩贛的軍閥由孫傳芳以五省聯軍名義統合；奉系首領張作霖在直奉戰敗後出任安國軍總司令，統一指揮直魯與奉系部隊；馮玉祥的國民軍與閻錫山的晉軍則在北伐後期相繼加入國民革命軍一方。蘇聯以遠東反日為前提，扶植北方的馮玉祥與南方的汪兆銘、蔣中正。北方三系雖屢次聯合，卻彼此算計、協同有限，戰局中北伐軍得以分進合擊、各個殲滅。
countriesEn: The Northern Expedition set the National Revolutionary Army of the Guangzhou government against a coalition of the different cliques of the Beiyang government. At the outset the National Revolutionary Army was organised into eight armies with a little over 100,000 men: the First Army under He Yingqin, the Fourth Army under Li Jishen (later taken over by Zhang Faku), the Second Army under Tan Yankai, the Third Army, which was the Yunnan contingent, under Zhu Peide, the Sixth Army under Cheng Qian, the New Guangxi clique's Seventh Army, and the Ninth and Tenth Armies, formed by taking over the Guizhou warlord Yuan Zuming's troops. Most armies carried a political department and a system of party representatives, with Chiang Kai-shek additionally serving as director of the Political Department of the National Revolutionary Army, so that party organisation was built directly into the chain of command. On the northern side, Wu Peifu, commander-in-chief of the Zhili clique, became commander-in-chief of the Anti-Bandit Allied Armies and appointed Ye Kaixin as commander of the Hunan contingent of that alliance, holding Huguang and Henan; the warlords of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian and Jiangxi were welded together by Sun Chuanfang under the title of the Five-Province Allied Army; and Zhang Zuolin, head of the Fengtian clique, after the defeat in the Zhili–Fengtian war became commander-in-chief of the National Pacification Army and took charge of the Zhilu–Fengtian forces; the Nationalist Army of Feng Yuxiang and the Shanxi army of Yan Xishan joined the National Revolutionary Army side in the later stages of the campaign. The Soviet Union, whose overriding concern in the Far East was Japan, chose to support Feng Yuxiang in the north and Wang Zhaoming and Chiang Kai-shek in the south. The three northern groups did combine from time to time, but they counted against one another and coordinated badly, and that is what allowed the expedition armies to converge from separate lines and destroy the enemy in detail.
people: 蔣中正是全役的策劃者。一九二六年七月九日就任國民革命軍總司令、在廣州誓師，九月再正式宣示必與帝國主義及軍閥決戰的方針，並在蘇聯顧問協助下確立集中兵力、各個擊破的總戰略：先殲吳佩孚，再滅孫傳芳，最後討張作霖。他同時主持政治工作與黨務，一九二七年四月十二日在上海發動清黨、四月十八日另立南京國民政府，八月十二日辭職離開南京，至一九二八年一月四日復職、二月再任總司令。譚延闓出師時任第二軍軍長，後任國民政府主席，寧漢分裂時曾以主席身分調停；李濟深任第四軍軍長，其部先後由張發奎、陳可鈺、陳銘樞等人率領，第四軍因汀泗橋、賀勝橋與武昌攻城之功被譽為鐵軍；何應欽任第一軍軍長，一九二六年九月奉命自潮汕進攻福建，擊潰周蔭人主力後升任東路總指揮；朱培德以第三軍滇系軍長率部入江西助攻，程潛任第六軍軍長；李宗仁、白崇禧於一九二七年五月分別由蕪湖與南京渡江，率軍攻取徐州。北方關鍵人物是吳佩孚、孫傳芳、張作霖與安國軍總司令張宗昌：吳佩孚在汀泗橋親臨督戰，兵敗退往河南信陽，武漢軍力被全消後率少數衛隊逃往四川；孫傳芳在龍潭戰敗後退回江北，一九二七年六月通電下野；張作霖退守關外，於皇姑屯被炸身亡，張學良同年底通電易幟。趙登禹率第二師在河南阻擊戰中殉國。
peopleEn: Chiang Kai-shek was the architect of the whole operation. On 9 July 1926 he took office as commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army and swore the army in at Guangzhou; in September he formally proclaimed the resolve to wage a decisive war against imperialism and the warlords, and, with the help of Soviet advisers, he fixed on the general strategy of concentrating forces and destroying the enemy in detail: annihilate Wu Peifu first, then Sun Chuanfang, and only afterwards Zhang Zuolin. He also ran the political work and the party affairs of the campaign, and it was he who launched the purge at Shanghai on 12 April 1927 and set up a separate Nanjing government on 18 April; he resigned and left Nanjing on 12 August, and did not formally resume office until 4 January 1928, taking command-in-chief again in February. Tan Yankai was commander of the Second Army at the outset and later chairman of the national government, and acted as chairman in the attempt to mediate the Nanjing–Wuhan split. Li Jishen commanded the Fourth Army, which was later led by Zhang Faku, Chen Keyu and Chen Mingshu in turn, and the Fourth Army earned the name of the Iron Army for its work at Tingsi Bridge, Hesheng Bridge and the assault on the walls of Wuchang. He Yingqin commanded the First Army and was ordered in September 1926 to attack Fujian from the Chaoshan area; after breaking the main force of Zhou Yinren he was promoted to commander of the eastern front. Zhu Peide, commanding the Third Army, which was the Yunnan contingent, took part in the drive into Jiangxi, while Cheng Qian commanded the Sixth Army. In May 1927 Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi crossed the Yangtze at Wuhu and at Nanjing respectively and took part in the drive on Xuzhou. The decisive northern figures were Wu Peifu, Sun Chuanfang, Zhang Zuolin and Zhang Zangchang, commander-in-chief of the National Pacification Army. Wu Peifu directed the defence at Tingsi Bridge in person, was beaten back and fell to Henan and Xinyang, and after his forces in Wuhan were wiped out he fled with a small escort to Sichuan. Sun Chuanfang was defeated at Longtan, withdrew north of the river and resigned by telegram in June 1927. Zhang Zuolin fell back to Northeast China and was blown up at Huangguhtun, and Zhang Xueliang declared for the government at the end of that year. Zhao Dengyu was killed while leading the Second Division in the fighting in Henan.
kits: 卡面所配的三八式步槍是一九〇五年定裝的日本陸軍制式步槍，口徑六點五毫米，五發彈匣，全長約一二七〇毫米，槍重約三點九五公斤，有效射程五百米，理論射速每分鐘十至十五發；槍身結構簡單、易於維修，長期是遠東產量最大、散布最廣的步槍。北伐期間，國民革命軍在兩湖、江西主戰線上的步兵主要裝備是漢陽兵工廠製造的仿德式步槍與國產中正式步槍，機槍多為德制七九二毫米重機槍的仿製品，砲兵以七五毫米級山炮為骨幹，迫擊炮以八二毫米為主。各軍裝備多由前任軍閥手中接收或購買，日造、德造、俄造、英造槍械並存，彈藥規格混雜，同一支連隊常常同時配發不同口徑的步槍，後勤極不統一；福建永定一役，北伐軍一次便繳獲四千餘支槍械與十多門火炮，可見戰利品之巨。而奉系軍隊的槍械大宗來自日本，三八式步槍在奉軍中裝備數量極大，因此在一九二八年二次北伐打到東北的戰線上，成為最常見的制式步槍；北伐軍接收奉軍倉庫之後，這批武器又大量流入東北地方武裝，一直延續到九一八事變之後。除步槍外，兩軍都大量使用手榴彈、地雷與輕機槍；攻城與反攻城作戰則依靠迫擊炮曲射壓制，機槍火力封鎖通道。騎兵部隊主要編在奉系、魯軍與西北軍，國民革命軍則以火車與汽車運輸為主，粵漢鐵路與後來接上的平漢線、津浦線成為全軍的補給命脈；少量飛機擔負偵察與對地攻擊，但規模有限。
kitsEn: The rifle on the card face is the Type 38, the standard infantry arm adopted by the Japanese army in 1905. It fires a 6.5 mm cartridge from a five-round magazine, measures about 1,270 mm in overall length, weighs about 3.95 kg, has an effective range of 500 metres and a theoretical rate of fire of ten to fifteen rounds a minute; its simple, easily serviced construction made it for a long time the most heavily produced and most widely distributed rifle in the Far East. During the Northern Expedition the infantry of the National Revolutionary Army on the Huguang and Jiangxi fronts were mainly armed with the German-pattern rifles made at the Hanyang arsenal and with the domestically produced Zhongzhengshi rifle; the machine guns were largely imitations of the German 7.92 mm heavy machine gun; the artillery was built around 75 mm mountain guns; and the mortars were mostly of the 82 mm type. Equipment had been bought from, or taken over from, the preceding warlords, so that Japanese-, German-, Russian- and British-made weapons existed side by side and the ammunition calibres were mixed — a single company was often issued rifles of different calibres at once, and the rear area was badly uncoordinated. In the fighting at Yongding in Fujian the government troops captured more than four thousand rifles and a dozen or more guns in a single action, which shows the scale of the spoils. The Fengtian armies bought their arms in bulk from Japan, and the Type 38 was carried in very large numbers by the Fengtian troops; it therefore became the commonest service rifle on the line in Northeast China during the second phase of the expedition in 1928. After the government forces took over the Fengtian depots, these rifles passed in great quantities into local armed groups in the northeast and remained in use long after the Mukden incident of 1931. Apart from rifles, both sides used hand grenades, mines and light machine guns in quantity, and in siege and defence work the deciding support came from the curved trajectory of mortars while machine-gun fire sealed off the approaches. Cavalry formations were raised mainly in the Fengtian, the Shandong and the northwestern armies, whereas the National Revolutionary Army relied on trains and motor lorries, with the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway and the Pinghan and Tientsin–Pukow lines that were later connected to it serving as the arteries of supply; a small number of aircraft carried out reconnaissance and ground attack, on a limited scale.
tactics: 北伐全程以粵漢鐵路為縱深主軸，總體採分進合擊。兵分三路：第四軍及第七軍各出半數共約三萬人由兩廣入湖南，會第八軍兩萬人主攻；第二軍、第三軍及第六軍共約三萬人入江西助攻；第一軍另一半由廣東東部伺機攻福建。初期作戰計畫甚至訂出以八萬人、軍餉五百萬，於三個月內佔領武漢的時限。湖南線上，第四軍克醴陵、第八軍三個師佔湘潭，七月十一日進佔長沙；獨立團等先鋒小單位以連為單位沿山路河谷突進，遇阻即側擊迂迴。八月十二日軍事會議決定以第四、第七、第八軍直取武漢。汀泗橋一戰，第四軍六個團正面攻擊一晝夜不克，汀泗橋幾度易手，八月二十七日由張發奎督率第三十五團與葉挺獨立團迂迴敵後奪佔；八月三十日賀勝橋，第八軍首先攻入敵陣地取得大捷，吳軍退守武漢。九月初兩次攻城不克後改為封鎖圍困，第八軍進漢陽、佔漢口，肅清兩岸；十月十日吳俊卿第三師開城，獨立團首先攻佔蛇山，守軍二萬餘人被殲。江西線上，蔣於擊破吳佩孚後以約五萬人三路進攻，九月十九日第十九師一度攻入南昌，二十四日退回奉新，蔣加派援軍二萬人再攻。福建線上，第一軍以廣東保安團與黃埔學生作防禦主力、第三師譚曙卿部作攻擊矛頭，十月九日襲佔永定。補給方面，糧彈與重火力沿粵漢鐵路北運，兵站由韶關經湖南向北展開，兵力補充靠收編地方武裝與歸附部隊；命令與計畫多賴鐵路與驛運傳遞，無線電報已用於軍級單位但覆蓋有限。一九二八年二次北伐改組為第一至第四集團軍，蔣中正四月一日親至徐州督師、四月七日下達總攻擊令，沿津浦、平漢兩線北進，馮玉祥第二集團軍自西北、閻錫山第三集團軍自山西策應。
tacticsEn: The whole campaign was fought along the axis of the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway, and in broad terms the plan was convergence from separate lines. The army was divided three ways: the Fourth and Seventh Armies each sent half their strength, about 30,000 men in all, from the Two Guangs into Hunan to join the 20,000 men of the Eighth Army in the main attack; the Second, Third and Sixth Armies, about 30,000 men, entered Jiangxi as supporting force; and the other half of the First Army waited in eastern Guangdong for the moment to strike into Fujian. The original plan even set a timetable: take Wuhan with 80,000 men and five million dollars of pay within three months. On the Hunan line the Fourth Army took Liling, three divisions of the Eighth Army occupied Xiangtan, and on 11 July the government forces entered Changsha; small vanguard formations such as the Independent Regiment advanced by company along mountain tracks and river valleys, turning and flanking obstacles. A military conference on 12 August decided that the Fourth, Seventh and Eighth Armies would strike straight at Wuhan. At Tingsi Bridge six regiments of the Fourth Army attacked frontally for a whole day and a night without success and the bridge changed hands several times, until on 27 August Zhang Faku, directing the Thirty-Fifth Regiment, and the Ye Ting Independent Regiment swung behind the enemy and carried the position. At Hesheng Bridge on 30 August the Eighth Army was the first to break into the enemy positions and won the day, and the northern forces fell back on Wuhan. Two assaults on Wuchang on 3 and 5 September having failed, the siege was turned into a blockade; the Eighth Army entered Hanyang and occupied Hankou, clearing both banks of the river. On 10 October the Third Division under Wu Junqing opened the city gates, the Independent Regiment seized Snake Hill first, and more than 20,000 of the defenders were wiped out. On the Jiangxi line, after breaking Wu Peifu, Chiang took the offensive with about 50,000 men in three columns; the Nineteenth Division entered Nanchang on 19 September, fell back towards Fengxin on the 24th, and Chiang sent 20,000 more men in reinforcement. On the Fujian line the First Army used the Guangdong security troops and the Whampoa students as a defensive screen and the Third Division under Tan Shuqing as the attacking spear, seizing Yongding on 9 October. On the supply side, grain, ammunition and heavy weapons moved north along the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway, with the depots running from Shaoguan through Hunan to the north, and replacements came from local militia and from units that came over. Orders and plans travelled mostly by rail and by courier, though wireless telegraphy was now used at army level, with limited coverage. The second phase of 1928 was reorganised into the First to Fourth Army Groups; Chiang Kai-shek went in person to Xuzhou to direct operations on 1 April and issued the general order of attack on 7 April, driving north along the Tientsin–Pukow and Pinghan lines, with the Second Army Group of Feng Yuxiang coming in from the northwest and the Third Army Group of Yan Xishan from Shanxi.
data: 可核對的數字集中在時序、兵力與繳獲三方面。時序上：一九二六年五月唐生智已歸附國民政府，葉挺獨立團更於五月即與吳佩孚部交戰；七月九日蔣中正就任總司令、廣州誓師；七月十一日進佔長沙；八月二十七日佔領汀泗橋，三十日取得賀勝橋大捷；九月一日逼近武昌，三日與五日兩次攻城不克，九月六日第八軍進漢陽、七日佔漢口；十月十日武昌城破，守軍二萬餘人被殲，劉玉春、陳嘉謨被生擒。一九二七年三月二十一日上海起義後東路軍開入市區；四月十二日清黨、四月十八日南京國民政府成立；五月馮玉祥攻克洛陽，六月一日與唐生智部會師鄭縣；六月二日佔領開封，吳佩孚率少數衛隊逃往四川；六月七日孫傳芳通電下野；八月十二日蔣中正辭職、十九日武漢政府遷南京。一九二八年四月一日蔣中正親至徐州督師、七日下總攻擊令；五月二十九日下令停止待命、議和平接收京津；六月三日張作霖離京、四日於皇姑屯被炸身亡；六月八日第三集團軍商震部開入北京；十二月二十九日東北易幟。兵力上：出師時國民革命軍共八個軍、十万餘人，三路各約三萬、三萬與兩萬，初期計畫為八萬人、軍餉五百萬、三個月佔領武漢；孫傳芳一度自江浙皖調兵十萬會同江西兩萬餘人；奉系在河南一度集兵約七萬；北伐前全國兵額約一百四十萬，北伐後增至二百三十萬，軍餉超過國家全部收入，遂有裁軍編遣之議。繳獲方面，福建永定一役俘虜四千、繳獲槍械四千餘支與火炮十多門。距離與規格方面，粵漢鐵路廣州至武昌約一千公里；三八式步槍口徑六點五毫米，五發彈匣，槍重約三點九五公斤，有效射程五百米。
dataEn: The verifiable figures fall into three kinds: chronology, strength and captures. On chronology: in May 1926 Tang Shengzhi had already declared for the Guangzhou government, and the Ye Ting Independent Regiment was already in contact with Wu Peifu's men in that same month; on 9 July Chiang Kai-shek took office as commander-in-chief and the army swore the oath at Guangzhou; on 11 July Changsha was taken; on 27 August Tingsi Bridge was carried and on the 30th Hesheng Bridge was won; on 1 September the army closed on Wuchang, assaults on the 3rd and 5th failed, the Eighth Army entered Hanyang on the 6th and occupied Hankou on the 7th; and on 10 October Wuchang fell, more than 20,000 of the garrison being wiped out and Liu Yuchun and Chen Jiaxu being taken prisoner. In 1927 the eastern armies entered Shanghai only after the rising of 21 March; the purge came on 12 April and the Nanjing government was set up on 18 April; in May Feng Yuxiang took Luoyang and on 1 June joined Tang Shengzhi's men at Zhengzhou; on 2 June Kaifeng was taken and Wu Peifu fled with a small escort to Sichuan; on 7 June Sun Chuanfang resigned by telegram; on 12 August Chiang Kai-shek resigned and on the 19th the Wuhan government moved to Nanjing. In 1928 Chiang Kai-shek went in person to Xuzhou on 1 April to direct operations and issued the general order of attack on the 7th; on 29 May he ordered the troops to stand down and negotiated with the diplomatic corps for a peaceful handover of Peking and Tientsin; on 3 June Zhang Zuolin left Peking by train and on the 4th was blown up at Huangguhtun; on 8 June the third Army Group under Shang Zhen entered Peking; and on 29 December the Northeast declared for the government. On strength: the National Revolutionary Army numbered eight armies and a little over 100,000 men at the outset, the three columns being about 30,000, 30,000 and 20,000 strong, while the original plan called for 80,000 men and five million dollars of pay to take Wuhan within three months; Sun Chuanfang at one point moved 100,000 men from Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui together with more than 20,000 already in Jiangxi; the Fengtian forces once massed some 70,000 men in Henan; and the total military establishment of the country rose from about 1.4 million before the expedition to 2.3 million after it, with military pay exceeding the entire revenue of the state, which is what led to the later decision to cut and reorganise the army. On captures: the fighting at Yongding in Fujian yielded four thousand prisoners, more than four thousand rifles and a dozen or more guns. On distance and specification: the Guangzhou–Wuchang railway ran about a thousand kilometres, while the Type 38 fires 6.5 mm, carries five rounds in the magazine, weighs about 3.95 kg and has an effective range of 500 metres.
cause: 北伐的起因，是廣州方面與北方軍閥長達十年的對峙終於走向軍事解決。一九二四年孫中山改組國民黨，推行聯俄、聯共、扶助農工三大政策，並在黃埔創辦陸軍軍官學校，同時組織國民革命軍；英美等列強在華支持的軍閥分別控制不同省份，關稅與借款抵押予外人，統一的呼聲因此高漲。一九二五年兩次廣州起義在敵對軍閥進攻下失敗，孫中山改以軍隊北進取代反叛式的起義。蘇聯的態度亦由反對轉為支持：一九二五年十月江浙軍閥孫傳芳聯合皖、贛、蘇、閩組成五省聯軍起兵反奉，吳佩孚出山受十四省擁戴就任討賊聯軍總司令，莫斯科擔心廣州方面北伐會令吳、孫腹背受敵、令反奉半途而廢，一度強烈譴責北伐；直至確認國民革命軍不會與北方合流，蘇聯才轉為積極扶持，扶植對象是北方的馮玉祥與南方的汪兆銘、蔣中正，並派季山嘉接替鮑羅廷擔任聯絡，提供軍事顧問、貸款與軍火。真正引爆的是湖南：一九二六年五月湖南代理省長唐生智歸附國民政府，第四軍獨立團與第七軍第八旅隨即開入湖南。北伐亦非單純反北洋：初期策略是聯絡馮玉祥國民軍及閻錫山牽制張作霖奉軍，聯絡川黔軍牽制吳佩孚、唐繼堯，中立孫傳芳，並以八萬人、軍餉五百萬於三個月內佔領武漢。吳、孫、張三系聯合之中互相算計，直系與江浙皖系在江西互相推諉，北伐軍因此得以分擊各個、各個殲滅。
causeEn: The Northern Expedition grew out of a decade of confrontation between the Guangzhou side and the northern warlords, which at last was to be settled militarily. In 1924 Sun Yat-sen reorganised the Kuomintang, adopted the three policies of alliance with Russia, alliance with the communists and support for workers and peasants, founded the Whampoa Military Academy at Huangpu, and organised the National Revolutionary Army. Warlords backed by Britain and the United States held different provinces in different hands, customs and foreign loans were mortgaged to outsiders, and the cry for unification grew louder. The two uprisings at Guangzhou in 1925 were defeated by the enemy warlords, and Sun then decided to advance north with regular armies rather than to stage another rebellion. Soviet policy itself swung from opposition to support: in October 1925 the Jiangsu and Zhejiang warlord Sun Chuanfang joined with those of Anhui, Jiangxi, Jiangsu and Fujian to form the Five-Province Allied Army and marched against Zhang Zuolin, and Wu Peifu came out of retirement to take command of the Anti-Bandit Allied Armies with the support of fourteen provinces; Moscow, fearing that a northern march from Guangzhou would leave Wu and Sun with the enemy on two fronts and spoil the anti-Fengtian war, condemned the expedition in the strongest terms; only after it was clear that the National Revolutionary Army would not merge with the northern groups did the Soviet Union turn to active sponsorship, backing Feng Yuxiang in the north and Wang Zhaoming and Chiang Kai-shek in the south, and sending Ji Shanjia to take over from Borodin as the liaison, with military advisers, credits and arms. What actually set the fuse alight was Hunan: in May 1926 Tang Shengzhi, acting governor of Hunan, declared for the Guangzhou government, and the Independent Regiment of the Fourth Army and the Eighth Brigade of the Seventh Army moved into Hunan at once. The expedition was not a simple anti-Beiyang rising either: the initial strategy was to bring Feng Yuxiang's Nationalist Army and Yan Xishan's Shanxi forces in against Zhang Zuolin, to bring the Sichuan and Guizhou troops in against Wu Peifu and Tang Jiyao, to leave Sun Chuanfang neutral, and to take Wuhan with 80,000 men and five million dollars of pay within three months. Within the northern alliance the three groups counted against one another, and Zhili and the Jiangsu–Zhejiang–Anhui forces shifted the blame for each other in Jiangxi, which is what allowed the expedition armies to win by striking one group at a time.
impact: 北伐最大的影響是改變了中國的權力結構。吳、孫、張三大軍閥政權在兩年之內相繼崩潰，一九二八年年底的東北易幟使國民政府取得形式上統一全國的名義，中央政權自此有了全國性的框架。軍閥時代並未真正終結：北伐前後全國兵額由約一百四十萬增至二百三十萬，軍餉超過國家全部收入，直接影響政府財政與預算編列，蔣中正遂決定裁軍編遣；但各路軍隊派系對裁軍的利益分配不均，日後遂演成中原大戰，而收編而來的派系化軍隊同時在國民革命軍內部形成中央系、桂系、滇系、湘系、晉系與奉系等長期割據格局。一九二七年的寧漢分裂更在國民黨內部造成深遠裂痕，形式統一之下始終存在派系對抗，影響其後對日作戰的組織與指揮。軍事層面上，北伐推動了軍隊的近代化：黨代表制、政治工作、軍事教育與新式射擊訓練自黃埔擴散到全國，湘、鄂、贛各省的民團被整編或解散，地方武裝的式微改變了鄉村社會的武力格局。武器層面的後果尤其長久，戰場上大量繳獲的日製三八式步槍與各式舊槍流入地方團體，一直使用到全面抗戰初期，成為抗戰軍隊底子的一部分；而南京政府取得列強對等承認、展開關稅自主談判，亦為後來的國際處境打下基礎。
impactEn: The greatest effect of the Northern Expedition was the transformation of the structure of power in China. The three great warlord regimes collapsed in turn within two years, and the declaration at the end of 1928 gave the national government the outward form of unity over the whole country; for the first time a central authority acquired a nationwide framework. The warlord era, however, did not truly end. The total military establishment of the country rose from about 1.4 million before the expedition to 2.3 million after it, military pay exceeded the entire revenue of the state and bore directly on the financing and the budget, and Chiang Kai-shek accordingly decided to cut and reorganise the army; but because the interest of the different factions in the distribution of that cut fell out unevenly, the affair ended in the Central Plains War, while the irregulars taken over into the army hardened at the same time into long-lived blocs within the National Revolutionary Army — the central, Guangxi, Yunnan, Hunan, Shanxi and Fengtian cliques. The Nanjing–Wuhan split of 1927 cut deep into the Kuomintang: beneath the outward unity factional conflict persisted, and it affected the organisation and command of the later war against Japan. On the military side the expedition drove forward modernisation: the system of party representatives, political work, military education and modern marksmanship training spread from Whampoa across the country; the local militia of Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi was either incorporated or disbanded, changing the pattern of armed power in the countryside. The consequences in weapons were the longest-lived of all: the large quantities of captured Japanese Type 38 rifles and other old guns dispersed into local groups and were still in service at the beginning of the full-scale war against Japan, forming part of the equipment base of the resistance armies. And the Nanjing government obtained recognition on equal terms from the foreign powers and opened negotiations on tariff autonomy, laying the foundation of its later international position.
result: 戰役以國民革命軍的全面勝利告終，但勝利分兩期取得。第一期自一九二六年七月至一九二七年八月，武漢三鎮的陷落使吳佩孚直系主力崩潰，他退往河南信陽、武漢軍力被全消，至一九二七年六月率少數衛隊逃往四川，北方一時以江浙皖系的孫傳芳為最強；寧漢分裂期間，唐生智自河南回師東征南京，徐州於八月六日得而復失，孫傳芳率軍渡江攻南京，經龍潭一戰大敗退回江北，南京平定；八月十二日蔣中正辭職、十九日武漢政府遷設南京，寧漢合流。第二期自一九二八年一月至六月，蔣中正復職後將長江中下游各軍改編為第一至第四集團軍，四月一日親至徐州督師、四月七日下達總攻擊令，連克郯城、台兒莊、兗州、泰安、濟寧、滕縣諸城，張宗昌敗退灤州，孫傳芳在北京宣布下野，張、孫殘部投降；五月二十九日蔣下令停止待命、與公使團議和平接收京津，六月三日張作霖乘火車離京、四日在皇姑屯被關東軍所炸身亡，六月八日第三集團軍商震部開入北京，北京改名北平；同年十二月二十九日張學良通電易幟，被任命為東北邊防司令長官，奉天省改稱遼寧省，名義上的全國統一於焉完成，首都由武漢遷回南京。各方對損失的數字記載分歧極大，雙方傷亡與被俘合計以數十萬計，但缺乏可核對的統計，較可信者僅為數個會戰的一次殲滅數量級，如武昌一戰被殲守軍二萬餘人。軍事上三個軍閥集團覆滅，部隊與地盤被重新分配；政治上國民政府建立了中央權威的外形，同時也把新的派系衝突帶進全國。北伐的成果此後並未走向穩定，而是隨著一九二九年以後的內戰與一九三一年後的對日危機，逐步被消耗殆盡。
resultEn: The campaign ended in complete victory for the National Revolutionary Army, but the victory was won in two stages. The first, from July 1926 to August 1927, ended with the loss of the three cities of Wuhan, which broke the main Zhili army of Wu Peifu: he fell back to Xinyang in Henan, his forces in Wuhan were wiped out, and in June 1927 he fled with a small escort to Sichuan, the strongest northern force for a time being the Jiangsu–Zhejiang–Anhui army of Sun Chuanfang. During the Nanjing–Wuhan split Tang Shengzhi turned back from Henan to march on Nanjing, Xuzhou was lost and retaken on 6 August, Sun Chuanfang led his troops across the river against Nanjing and was beaten in the battle of Longtan, the remnants of two or three ten thousand men swimming back north of the river, and Nanjing was settled. On 12 August Chiang Kai-shek resigned, and on the 19th the Wuhan government moved to Nanjing, the two governments being reunited. The second stage ran from January to June 1928: after Chiang resumed office the armies of the middle and lower Yangtze were reorganised into the First to Fourth Army Groups; on 1 April he went in person to Xuzhou to direct operations and on the 7th issued the general order of attack; Tancheng, Taierzhuang, Yanzhou, Tai'an, Jining and Tengxian fell in turn, Zhang Zangchang was driven back to Luanzhou, Sun Chuanfang announced his resignation at Peking, and the remnants of both surrendered. On 29 May Chiang ordered the troops to stand down and negotiated with the diplomatic corps for a peaceful handover of Peking and Tientsin; on 3 June Zhang Zuolin left Peking by train and on the 4th was blown up at Huangguhtun by the Kwantung Army; on 8 June the third Army Group under Shang Zhen entered Peking, which was renamed Beiping. On 29 December of the same year Zhang Xueliang declared for the government and was appointed commander-in-chief of the Northeast Frontier Defence, the province of Fengtian being renamed Liaoning, and the nominal unity of the country was thus completed, the capital returning from Wuhan to Nanjing. The accounts of the losses differ enormously from one source to another; the dead, wounded and captured on both sides run into the hundreds of thousands, but there is no verifiable tally, and the only figures that can be treated with any confidence are the order of magnitude of the annihilations in a handful of major battles, such as the more than 20,000 defenders wiped out at Wuchang. Militarily the three warlord groups were destroyed and troops and territory were redistributed; politically the national government acquired the outward form of a central authority while carrying new factional conflicts into the country as a whole. The fruits of the Northern Expedition did not lead to stability, but were gradually spent in the civil wars that followed from 1929 and in the Japanese crisis that opened with 1931.
